mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_action (action_id, task_id, run_id, agent_name, parent_agent, tool_name, tool_call_id, status, permission_decision, created_at, updated_at, started_at, ended_at) VALUES (#{actionId}, #{taskId}, #{runId}, #{agentName}, #{parentAgent}, #{toolName}, #{toolCallId}, #{status}, #{permissionDecision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_action WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_action WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_action SET status = #{status}, permission_decision = #{permissionDecision}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE action_id = #{actionId}
